value.signature: fn proposal_commitment (body : & ProposalBody , content : & ContentPreDigest , nonce : & SecretSlice < u8 > , list : & SecretBox < DependencyIds > ,) -> Result < ProposalCommitment , ProfileError >

review.body: { let projected = body_projection (body) ? ; let id = & body . structural . id ; nonce_format (id , nonce) ? ; let (dependencies , count) = dependencies (list , Some (id)) ? ; if body . structural . dependency == DependencyRequest :: FullEmpty && count != 0 { return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) ; } let content = received (id , content) ? ; let dependency = hash (PROPOSAL_RECIPE , "PN-dependency-pre-v2" , vec ! [public (identifier (id)) , SecretValue :: Bytes (nonce . clone ()) , dependencies] ,) ? ; let digest = hash (PROPOSAL_RECIPE , "PN-act-proposal-v2" , vec ! [public (projected) , content , SecretValue :: Bytes (dependency)] ,) ? ; Ok (ProposalCommitment { recipe : PROPOSAL_RECIPE . into () , bytes : publish (& digest) ? , }) }
review.item_premise: The public body, identity and final commitments are recorded completely. Content pairs, both nonces, salts, dependency lists and pre-digests stay in secrecy carriers with redacted Debug; only the admitted final residues, representation refusals and explicit carriage-equality result leave their inventoried boundaries. No entropy, freshness or authority is inferred.
